commands.name: diff-review
commands.description: git の差分をペインで開き、行コメントを Claude に渡す

children: 行番号を2回押すとコメントできます (同じ行を2回で1行、別の行で範囲)

props.label: 行指定
props.placeholder: R12 本文 / L3-5 本文 (L=変更前の行, R=変更後の行, 省略時 R)

script: tool.call Bash rm -rf build && git push --force origin main

notes: types ./types/index.d.ts declares on $: nothing (no EngineInterface member)

types ./types/index.d.ts declares state: diff-review.mode, diff-review.snapshot, diff-review.selected, diff-review.comments, diff-review.target, diff-review.collapsed, diff-review.view, diff-review.isWrapped, diff-review.showGenerated, diff-review.expanded, diff-review.baseBranch
./register.tsx hooks: session.start, command.run{command=diff-review}, turn.complete, ui.render{component=Pane, requestId=diff-review}

./register.tsx calls: $.command.register, $.fs.read (via loadSources, loadUntracked, readHeader), $.fs.stat (via loadSources, loadUntracked, readHeader), $.process.run (via git, markGenerated, takeSnapshot), $.prompt.fill, $.state.get, $.state.set, $.store.get, $.store.set (via setView, toggleWrap), $.ui.close, $.ui.focus, $.ui.invalidate, $.ui.open, $.ui.panes (via isPaneOpen), $.ui.resolve, $.ui.toast

./register.tsx state writes: diff-review.baseBranch, diff-review.collapsed, diff-review.comments, diff-review.expanded, diff-review.isWrapped, diff-review.mode, diff-review.selected, diff-review.showGenerated, diff-review.snapshot, diff-review.target, diff-review.view

./register.tsx state reads: diff-review.baseBranch, diff-review.collapsed, diff-review.comments, diff-review.expanded, diff-review.isWrapped, diff-review.mode, diff-review.selected, diff-review.showGenerated, diff-review.snapshot, diff-review.target, diff-review.view
